name: bundled-chat
description: The small Apache-2.0 chat model that ships with PersonalClaw so a fresh install can hold a conversation before any provider is bound. Runs on your machine with no account, no API key and no network. It is deliberately tiny, so it is only ever the floor: bind a real model in Settings → Models and this stops being used.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Answer when nothing else is bound
x-meta.help: On by default: with no provider configured, this model answers chat so a fresh install is not a dead end. Turn it off to go back to the calm “set up a model” state instead.

x-meta.label: Maximum reply length
x-meta.help: Tokens. This model runs on the CPU at roughly 5–50 tokens per second, so a long cap means a long wait.

x-meta.label: Prompt budget
x-meta.help: Tokens of conversation sent to the model. The weight can take 8192, but every token costs a full pass over the weights; the oldest turns are dropped first. Lowering this below 4096 speeds up replies and can start refusing longer questions.

x-meta.label: Temperature
x-meta.help: 0 is greedy decoding, which is the most coherent setting at this model size. Above 0 samples with nucleus (top-p) selection.

x-meta.label: Top-p
x-meta.help: Nucleus sampling mass. Ignored when temperature is 0.

x-meta.label: Repetition penalty
x-meta.help: Small models loop without this. 1.0 disables it.
